description: Find an item before using buy_*: filter the shelf by price or text, or pass item_id for its listing. Rows give USDC price, fulfillment and read scope. Free, read-only, no account. Results stay in shelf order; nothing is ranked or recommended. A listing is not a stock check. Invalid lookups return a free next_step.

item_id.description: One item's id. It replaces search rather than narrowing it: q and max_price_usdc are not applied, and the answer is that one item in full.

max_price_usdc.description: A ceiling in USDC. Items at or below it match.

q.description: Words to match against an item's id, name, subtitle and description.

name: find_in_catalog

how_this_was_ordered.description: That the order is the shelf's own and nothing is ranked.

items.description: The rows, in the shelf's own order.
One shelf row, in the shelf's own order.

buy_url.description: The x402 door that sells it.

buy_url_template.description: Where present, buy this instead: the door with its required inputs as <slot>s to fill.

fulfillment.description: instant, or human-fulfilled with a window.

id.description: The item id a buy_* call or item_id lookup takes.

listing_url.description: The room that describes it in full.

price_tiers_usdc.description: Every price this item is sold at, cheapest first.

price_usdc.description: The lowest price on this row, in USDC.

reads.description: The declared class of observations this item makes.

subtitle.description: The one-line gloss, when the item has one.

of.description: How many are on the shelf, the denominator.

publications.description: Publication indexes outside menu search; archived collections are opt-in, not current offerings.

query.description: The filter that was applied, echoed.

whole_catalogue.description: The full catalogue, for a caller that wants every field.

security.the_rest: What this store never does, the standards it holds itself to, and where to report a vulnerability or a correction: https://scvd.store/mcp.md#what-every-tool-here-promises. Reporting directly: https://scvd.store/.well-known/security.txt, https://scvd.store/corrections.
security.what_it_stores_about_you: Calls contribute to rate limits and traffic counts. No caller account or cookie; private status reads require the purchase handle.
security.what_this_does_in_your_name: Nothing at all. The good is produced here from what you sent, and no request leaves this store to make it. This store never asks for a credential, private key, or wallet secret. Payment uses buyer-signed x402 authorizations.

summary: Free catalog search by price, text or item_id. Returns listings, not stock availability.
title: Find Something on the Shelf
